headline: No decisions recorded; this document is a meeting notice listing agenda items such as minutes, correspondence, and old and new business.
summary: This document is a meeting notice and agenda, not minutes. It lists items such as approval of minutes, correspondence, the trust report, the superintendent's report, old business, new business, and general cemetery business. It records no votes or decisions.

September 8, 2026
A meeting of the Board of Trustees of Cemeteries will be held on 
Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at 5:00 P.M. at the Forest Dale 
Cemetery Office, 150 Forest Street, Malden, Massachusetts.
 Please Note: “If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please 
contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 
781-397-7000, Ext 2005”
